defects: Give the Dawn council a public landmark that reads above the broad hut roof at 48 px, such as a paired living-bough entry frame with a broad leaf-green council standard. Separate the landing edge from the wall in value.

The pale substrate punches through the near green roofing blade. Reprofile or locally recess the underlying thatch so that the graft has one continuous margin under the normal camera. Check the opposite side and all three LODs.

rounds.critic: Lead agent, independent of the Elf Town Centers builder
rounds.inspection: Opened all ten individual PNGs, the 48 px contact sheet and the 40-view sheet rendered directly from exported LODs. Revalidated each GLB. All 30 LODs have zero co-oriented coplanar overlaps. Inspected the revised stair rise, Y=0 annex foundations and metal wishbone.

models.observations: The offset copper-tipped chamber reads above the first canopy even at 48 px. The terracotta drum, green canopy and paired honey-coloured pods separate into three clear values. The stairs abut the landing cleanly on the revised mesh.

The slate-capped outboard chamber creates a dark upright accent beside the broad living canopy. The orange lancets identify the entrance side. The annex masonry reaches the ground on both sides, including the reverse view and silhouette LOD.

The broad seed standard and the two gate trunks now make a public entrance visible at 48 px. The cool stair separates from the brown wall. At front and back the green roof panels present complete blades beside the straw wedges. The gate frame persists through the silhouette LOD.

The little belfry, slate canopy and annex form three distinct roof heights. The external corner of the lit chapel now bears on a continuous stone ring. The crown and main doorway stay legible at the smallest size.

The uninterrupted terracotta dome terminates in a continuous gold cornice. The pale side chamber rests on its widened stone plinth. The leaf roofs on the cupola and annex connect this silhouette to earlier Elf buildings.

The pale colonnade supports a shallow leaf parasol, with two boughs rising beyond its edge. The open rhythm between the posts and the front stairs remains readable at 48 px. The three exported levels preserve the rotunda.

An open gold ring surrounds a pale-blue seed above the pearl canopy. The forked ring supports remain evident from the front and back. At 48 px the seed, opening and the shaded entry retain their separate shapes.

Three narrowing glazed tiers and a cyan crown rise from a compact leaf skirt. Pendant lights and the small standard distinguish the public entry. The tower profile and material bands hold in the lower levels.

The strong V-shaped steel fork now carries the green sail above the white canopy at phone size. A low concrete foot supports the blue terrace. Reverse and lower-detail views preserve the lifted tip and the horizontal glazing.

The pair of unequal stacks grow out of a grounded brick boiler wing. A continuous green sector crosses the steel roof without holes, visible from both approaches. Tiny lanterns mark the public door below the roof.
